description: The release log of an app: every deployment per environment, newest first, with a derived status (live / replaced / rolled back / failed / auto-reverted / in progress), its label, What's New text, who deployed it (person or agent), commit, how long it was live, and what the app saw while it was live (requests, active users, restarts, and the same per day). Error rate and p95 latency are always null: AppCrane does not record them. Filter by env and label to compare releases, e.g. label "rules=v3" against "rules=v2". Owner, app admin or platform admin only. For a plain deploy history any member can read, use appcrane_list_releases.

label.description: Only releases with exactly this label.

stage.description: Omit for both environments. Target stage (legacy alias: env).

name: appcrane_list_app_releases
